prepared_payload.prompt:
One continuous 8-second shot with no cuts. Use the supplied image as the first frame. Maintain its framing with a locked camera throughout. Keep the lips gently closed during every segment while performing the requested actions. Do not articulate words or add speaking mouth movements.
0-3s: Hold the front-facing close-up; the man lowers his eyes, lips closed. 3-6s: He lifts his gaze toward his companion just beside the camera, with a reluctant small nod. 6-8s: Hold a thoughtful expression. Locked camera, natural blinking, no talking, no music, no subtitles.
Do not add background music.
Use only natural ambient sound; no speech, narration or voiceover.

observations.sampling: All three videos inspected at 2 fps (16 frames each); does not prove every-frame continuity or audio compliance.
observations.original: No conspicuous open-mouth action in sampled frames; gaze lowering and raising visible.
observations.adapted_v2: Open-mouth action persists around 2.5-4.5s despite strengthened constraint.
observations.shared: Same character/cafe appearance across sampled frames; no obvious cut; small nod is not independently quantified.
observations.verdict: Conversion integration passed. Quality superiority unproven; v2 was not promoted to default. No automated best-prompt claim.

known_limits: One output per prompt; random sampling uncontrolled
No independent audio transcription, voice or lip-sync test
Resident supports only the documented narrow silent first-frame profile
Original source is agent-authored Seko input, not an official/community Skill output
No new software or dependencies installed
